notes: Screening captures use 30 seconds of uneven real key input.
portrait-candidate contains the production culling algorithm with two-tile margins and unchanged cache warming, before the diagnostic labeling and stale-context guards.
Portrait final captures with mismatched fixed-rate cadence are excluded from displayed-stutter improvement claims. Their raw summaries remain here.
Off-cadence checks are diagnostics for these known fixed-rate displays, not a general VRR validity test.
